note: Regression corpus for run_checks.cjs. Every rule the linter enforces has one positive and one negative case (references/promotion-rule.md, rule 6). A promoted rule that ships without both is not promoted. Never edit a case so a new article passes.

cases.reason: valid da/en pair: schema complete, every claim sourced and fetched, keyword placed, LIX under ceiling
a target keyword containing a digit ("prøve i dansk 3") opening the article must satisfy the first-100-words check
same digit-bearing keyword, absent from the opening — the check must still be able to fail
an unsourced figure rescued with a hedge instead of being cut (the observed baseline failure)
a claim with no source at all
a fee claim citing a language school rather than the kommune or the legal text
an exam date known only from a search snippet, because the page never loaded

cases.match: must list the claim ids it was computed from
cases.reason: a total the writer worked out themselves, presented as if sourced
a claim dropped from the English version only
English keyword translated from the Danish one instead of chosen for English search
nominalised academic Danish aimed at a B1 reader
